name: tile
need: Show key figures at the top of a page, how they moved, and filter by one

--ds-tile-radius-pressed.description: a clickable tile while pressed (times `--ds-shape`; never rounder than the rest radius)

--ds-tile-padding.description: a tile's padding (the head 4px less), 2px per density step

--ds-tile-min-width.description: the narrowest tile of a `.ds-tiles` row (fewer per row below it; one per row on a phone, 128px keeps two down to a 360px phone)

--ds-tiles-columns.description: the most tiles per row (`.ds-tiles--3`: three)

--ds-tile-value-line.description: the line height of `.ds-tile__value` at the md size; a size step scales it with the value
